header: How one total splits across named buckets
lead: The band-level figure holds the total the shares refer to; each row's value draws its own bar and is written out at the end of the row. Nothing checks that the shares add up — that arithmetic is the editor's.
note: Use Share Bar when the split should read as a single bar, and Bar Comparison when the rows are independent measures that do not add up to anything.
